title: Orchard and Songbook
author: Oscar Iversen
blurb: Lior Hartwell, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
